referral_policies:
1.1. Policy Brief and Purpose
Our Employee Referral Program Policy explains important aspects of our employee referral procedures. We place great importance on referrals because we trust our employees know what’s best for our company. We want to make this process as smooth as possible for our employees and those whom they refer.
As we continue to grow, we must ensure that we attract the right people who understand our vision and values and assist us to drive growth. ChicMic Studios is, therefore, resolved to provide a framework of rules which will enable the organization to operate the employee referral program in a very effective and frictionless manner.
1.2. Scope
All employees are eligible to participate in our referral program except for Recruiters and Hiring Managers(Team Leads of teams for which hiring is being done) for positions for which they’re hiring.
Note that hiring managers can’t refer anyone for a position for which they are directly or indirectly responsible. But, they can refer someone for a position that’s in a different department, office or function. Exception to this rule requires written consent from management ie CEO/COO.
1.3. General Rules
The organization shall evaluate all referrals and does not guarantee hiring and selection shall be as per the hiring policy. Information on the selection and hiring decision shall remain private with the hiring authority and the employee will receive the necessary update on the status of referral. Any malpractice in employee referral is a serious offense and normally considered as a zero tolerance area. The organization will take necessary actions as deemed appropriate in the best interest of the organization.
1.4. Referral
To refer a potential employee, an employee shall email the detail of the position applied for and submit to HR along with the resume of the candidate. Employees shall be eligible for a referral award only when the referred candidate has not applied to the organization through direct channels and has not given an interview in the last one year. For each referral hiring, the organization shall pay the referral incentive as per the Schedule 1 published by HR via email for open positions from time to time. The referral incentive payout shall be uniform, irrespective of the role/level of the referee. The referral incentive payment shall happen only when the newly hired employee has worked at least 90 days in the organization and his/her probation is confirmed. If more than one employee refers to the same candidate, the first referee shall receive the referral incentive.
The organization reserves the rights to modify or cancel the Employee Referral programme for a position, anytime without a formal announcement. The referral incentive payout shall be issued via bank transfer to employees' salary account. In case if the employee who has referred a candidate becomes eligible for referral payment but no longer exists as an employee (left the organization before the payment is due), the organization shall not pay any incentive. An employee can refer any number of candidates. An employee can earn a maximum of 5 referral incentives per calendar. Once the incentive is due for payment, the HR department shall issue an email to issue the referral payment, and forward to Management. Management shall make the payment along with the next salary payment and intimate HR as well as Employee. The referral incentive payment is subject to deduction of income tax, if applicable.
1.5. Grievances on Referral
Employees shall file grievances to the Management via email and mark a copy to HR too.
1.6. Referral Bonus is not applicable in case of
Candidate applies directly and does not mention referring employee’s details on the day one of the interview.
Employee has not shared the candidate’s details with us in advance before the commencement of the interview process via email.
If the candidate does not achieve the threshold status or completes the minimum duration (at least 90 days)
